name: Existing Landsat/proxy baseline reproduction
technical_note: Exact legacy outputs reproduced in isolated run; validation gates checked.

name: Data acquisition and completeness
technical_note: Workspace inventory, four Open-Meteo weather cells and source manifests created.

name: Open-Meteo weather analysis
technical_note: 1991–2025 ERA5-Seamless daily data acquired and quality controlled.

name: Open-Meteo versus NASA POWER
technical_note: Daily, seasonal, annual and extreme-event agreement quantified; neither treated as ground truth.

name: Historical climate variability and trends
technical_note: Annual/seasonal metrics, Theil-Sen slopes, moving-block intervals and FDR produced.

name: Weather during Landsat epochs
technical_note: Weather matched to every retained scene date and aggregated to composite epochs.

name: Weather-spectral relationships
technical_note: Five unique epochs; descriptive lag associations and leave-one-epoch sensitivity only.

name: Terrain and hydrological susceptibility
technical_note: Elevation, slope, D8 convergence, wetness proxy and drainage distance analysed.

name: Integrated component priority
technical_note: Hierarchical landscape/terrain score plus climate context; not monument risk.

name: Scale sensitivity
technical_note: 250/500/1000 m Spearman, Kendall, top-k and reversals quantified.

name: Redundancy analysis
technical_note: Indicator correlations and NDVI/NDBI grouping decision recorded.

name: Factor and domain ablation
technical_note: Leave-factor and leave-domain ranking effects calculated.

name: Weighting uncertainty
technical_note: 50,000 Dirichlet domain-weight simulations reproduced; expert weights unavailable.

name: Block-bootstrap uncertainty
technical_note: 2,000 150 m spectral-block ranking draws plus 2,000 test-block model draws.

name: Proxy-model comparison
technical_note: Legacy 79/21 split reproduced and stricter buffered split executed with calibration.

name: Optional ancillary hazards
technical_note: No reliable harmonised event inventory was required for the central question; scope preserved.
